definitions: The subject of a talk, piece of writing, exhibition, etc.; a topic.
A melodic phrase or passage that is repeated or developed in a piece of music.
An idea that recurs in or pervades a work of art or literature.
A topic for discussion or a recurring idea.
examples: The theme of the conference was 'Sustainable Living'.
The composer developed the main theme throughout the symphony.
Love and loss are common themes in her novels.
The restaurant had a medieval theme.
The theme of the debate was climate change.
